# Self-Steering Manifest
#
# Authoritative mapping of canonical steering files to their generated
# runtime copies under .kiro/steering/.
#
# Format: <sort-prefix> <canonical-relative-path> <title>
#
# - sort-prefix: two-digit number controlling load order
# - canonical-relative-path: path relative to repository root
# - title: human-readable name used in generated file headers
#
# Both scripts/sync-self-steering.sh and scripts/sync-self-steering.ps1
# consume this manifest. Do not create a second mapping elsewhere.
#
# To add a new canonical steering file:
#   1. Create the file under kiro/global-steering/
#   2. Add a line to this manifest
#   3. Run the synchronization script
#
# To remove a canonical steering file:
#   1. Remove its line from this manifest
#   2. Run the synchronization script (obsolete generated file is deleted)
#   3. Remove the canonical file if no longer needed

00 kiro/global-steering/engineering-foundation.md Engineering Foundation
01 kiro/global-steering/security-baseline.md Security Baseline
02 kiro/global-steering/testing-baseline.md Testing Baseline
03 kiro/global-steering/documentation-language.md Documentation Language
04 kiro/global-steering/ai-execution-rules.md AI Execution Rules
